tools.name: end_session
tools.description: End a session declared with `start_session`: removes its agent cursor, stops any recording it owns, and clears its per-session config. Call this when a run finishes so its cursor doesn't linger (otherwise the idle-TTL reclaims it after a period of inactivity). Idempotent.

tools.description: Unlock the desktop phase of an auto capture-scope session after the window action ladder has been exhausted and verified. This is a one-way transition for the live session and records a bounded reason.

detail.description: Optional bounded diagnostic detail. Never use secrets or page content.

tools.name: set_window_frame

tools.name: start_session
tools.description: Declare a session — a named, color-coded identity for THIS agent run. Pass a stable `session` id and choose capture_scope=auto|window|desktop; the agent cursor, capture policy, per-session config, and recording all key on it, and it follows the run across any apps/windows. The cursor's color is derived from the id, so distinct runs are visually distinct. A cursor is shown only for a declared session — call this (or pass `session` on your first action) to opt in. Idempotent: re-calling with the same id just refreshes its idle-TTL. End it with `end_session` (or let the idle-TTL reclaim it). Concurrent runs/subagents each pass their own `session` to get their own cursor.

capture_scope.description: Per-session perception/action modality. auto starts window-only and requires explicit escalation before desktop tools; window and desktop are strict. Immutable for the live session.

cursor_theme.description:
Optional initial cursor theme. The host applies it before the cursor is
first made visible, avoiding a flash of the default theme.

session.description: Stable session id for this run (e.g. "research-run-1").

tools.name: type_text
tools.description: Type text into the current foreground desktop application.

tools.name: verify_state
tools.description: Deterministically verify bounded predicates against one exact window. The driver evaluates structured window/accessibility state and may return the final screenshot as uninterpreted visual evidence for a multimodal caller. Predicate results are satisfied, unsatisfied, or unknown; unknown never implies success. Accessibility projections are conservative: absence remains unknown unless the observed search domain is proven exhaustive.

expect.description: One to eight predicates, combined with logical AND.

exists.description:
Assert that at least one trusted element matches the selector.

Element walks are not yet exhaustive on every platform, so absence
cannot be proven. `false` is rejected instead of returning an
indefinitely-unknown predicate.

include_screenshot.description:
Return the final window screenshot as image content for a multimodal
caller. The driver does not interpret that image.

pid.description: Exact process whose window may be observed.

session.description: Optional session id for capture-scope and authorization continuity.

stable_samples.description: Consecutive satisfied samples required before returning success.

timeout_ms.description: Bounded wait. Zero performs one sample.
